label: AC-2(3)
title: Disable Accounts

statement.prose: Disable accounts within {{ insert: param, ac-02.03_odp.01 }} when the accounts:

children.label: (b)
children.prose: Are no longer associated with a user or individual;

children.label: (c)
children.prose: Are in violation of organizational policy; or

children.label: (d)
children.prose: Have been inactive for {{ insert: param, ac-02.03_odp.02 }}.

guidance: Disabling expired, inactive, or otherwise anomalous accounts supports the concepts of least privilege and least functionality which reduce the attack surface of the system.

params.label: time period
guidelines: time period within which to disable accounts is defined;

params.label: time period
guidelines: time period for account inactivity before disabling is defined;
